item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Change Only the Bottle

turns.text: Turn just the black bottle forest green, still matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow.

item.tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

answer_sheet.Target object: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New appearance: Forest green with the existing matte finish and shading.
answer_sheet.Allowed edit area: Only the bottle itself. Leave the table, background and cast shadow unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the square composition without cropping or shifting; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.
